thread:
mira (partner-ops): Quick thread: packaging differences across AWS/GCP/Azure for the same SKU. We need a small mapping doc so ops can ingest the manifest per portal. Who can help map fields?

oliver (product): I'll draft the mapping table. Plan: canonical manifest -> cloud-specific field names + short notes. Target Wed AM.

kate (legal): Reminder: each portal has different display rules for legal bullets. AWS allows a short legal note; GCP prefers a link to policies; Azure wants a contract reference. We need to craft three variants of the EULA excerpt.

diego (cloud-int): Also note: AWS wants AMI/bit/region-specific images for marketplace VMs; for our listing which is API-only, include sample deployment/config instead.

zane (eng): I'll create a minimal `marketplace-adapter` script to transform the canonical manifest into platform-specific JSONs. It will be a small js file that replaces keys and validates required fields.

mira (partner-ops): Owners/timeline: oliver -> canonical mapping by Wed AM; zane -> adapter script Wed EOD; diego -> note on region/AMI/docs Wed EOD; kate -> legal text by Wed EOD.

marketplace-bot: FYI: Publishing to all three can take 1-2 weeks once assets and legal are provided. Include contact emails to speed manual reviews.

oliver (product): Draft manifest snippet (canonical):
```json
{
  "sku_id":"redwood-core-std",
  "display_name":"Redwood Core (Standard)",
  "short_description":"Low-latency LLM inference API for production.",
  "pricing": {"type":"metered","meter_name":"red_tokens","unit":"token"}
}
```

kate (legal): I'll produce 3 condensed legal lines for storefronts and a link to the full EULA/DPA pdf.

diego (cloud-int): Small tip: include a `support_contact` field with an ops contact and preferred timezone; some portals surface that directly.

zane (eng): I'll push the adapter to the partnership drive with instructions: `node adapt.js canonical.json --target=aws > aws.json`. Also include a small validation of required keys (consent_text, meter tags).

mira (partner-ops): Great. I'll collate outputs and schedule a dry-run publish to AWS sandbox after we have the cloud-specific JSONs. Will ping when ready.

oliver (product): Adding a `portal_notes` key where we can add portal-specific guidance (e.g., which image to reference or which SKU field maps to the store's "Trial" checkbox).

mira (partner-ops): Perfect. Thanks everyone. I'll create the PR and tag reviewers.

marketplace-bot: Tip: include localized storefront assets if you plan to enable non-US regions. Some portals require localized text for EU/JP.

mira (partner-ops): Noted — we will start with EN and add localizations later.
